cast.name: 薇薇安·米德马 Vivianne Miedema

this_title: Step by Step: Viv and Beth's ACL Journey
introduction: Step By Step is a five-part series charting the duo's absences and rehab as they battle back from their serious setbacks to star once again for our women's team. Our cameras were around for every key moment of their journeys back to fitness, including pre-and post-surgery, and their first steps back into training, and shine a light on the mental, as well as the physical, toll of not being able to play the game they love.As well as that, Beth and Viv explore why the issue of ACL injuries is so prevalent in the women’s game, and look into what is being done to help the next generation of female players avoid the same lengthy layoffs that they have suffered. （Source:www.arsenal.com)这是一个由五集组成的纪录片系列，记录了球员贝丝·米德和薇薇安·米德马在克服严重挫折后重返阿森纳女子足球队的过程。摄影团队记录了她们康复过程中的每个关键时刻，包括手术前后以及她们重新开始训练的第一步。同时聚焦于无法参与她们热爱的足球比赛所带来的心理和身体上的双重打击。不仅如此，贝丝和薇薇安还尝试追寻为什么ACL损伤在女子比赛中如此普遍的原因，并深入探讨了为了帮助下一代女球员避免经历她们所经历的漫长休养期所应该采取的措施。
